Its uninstall sentence ("revokes every `sys_user_permission_set` grant naming one of its sets") becomes false with PR #32223. It is replaced by one sentence saying that grants bound to the package or to no package are revoked, that a grant bound to another holder stays, and that an unbound grant of a name another holder keeps is revoked and named under `reportedGrants`. No other path.

domain:server#4 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi1tLRTEYwYGtbNCyk

Delivered by PR #32223 (merged as `bb67b987`, at head `ea824acc`). Uninstalling a package now revokes only the `sys_user_permission_set` grants bound to that package or bound to no package. A grant bound to another holder stays. An unbound grant of a name another package still holds is revoked and reported: one `warn`, plus `reportedGrants` on the uninstall receipt (`{ user, organization, permission_set }`, present only when non-empty). Single-holder uninstall answers are unchanged. `pm:dispatched` and `pm:blocking` removed.

Unblocked: #31698 PR-2 (`domain:server#3`).
